question: Agra Fort is one of the popular Mughal monuments built in the 16th century by ________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akbar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Agra Fort 

 
 
• It is located on the right bank of the Yamuna River in the historical city of Agra in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• This grand structure was built by the Mughal emperor Akbar in the year 1573.
 
• The structure displays the architectural grandeur of the Mughal dynasty in India.
 
• The fort complex was assigned a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983.
 
 
 
• **Akbar period architecture**
 
 
• Buland Darwaza
 
• Tomb of Shesh Salim Chishti
 
• Panch Mahal
 
• Palace of Jodhabai or Mariam-uz-Zamani
 
• Ibadatkhana
 
• Pachisi Aangan
 
• Hiran Minar
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shah Jahan**

 
 
• Shahjahan the fifth Mughal emperor of India was the son of Jahangir. His grandfather Akbar gave him the name Khurram.
 
• He was given the title of "The Builder of the Marvels" as he had a remarkable ability to design new structures and redesign old forts.
 
• He built the Taj Mahal in Agra, the Moti Masjid in Lahore, the Jama Masjid of Delhi, and a Section of Agra Fort, etc.**​**
 
 
 
• Humayun (1530 to 1540 and again from 1555 to 1556)
 
 
• Babur's son Humayun ascended the throne of India three days after Babur's death in 1530.
 
• Six months after his accession, Humayun besieged the fortress of Kalinjar in Bundelkhand.
 
• And gained a decisive victory over Afghans at Douhrua and drove out Mahmood Lodi and even defeated Bahadur Shah of Gujarat.
 
• Humayun forces were defeated by Afghan ruler Sher Shah Suri at Chausa near Buxar in June 1539.
 
• On May 17, 1540, the Mughals and the Afghans met again opposite Kannauj.
 
• His hopelessly demoralised army was defeated at the battle commonly known as the Battle of Kannauj.
 
• Humayun captured **Rohtas Fort and** **Lahore **in February **1555**. 
 
 
 
• Babur
 
 
• Babur was born in 1483 in Andijan, which is now Uzbekistan.
 
• His father was the ruler of the small kingdom of Ferghana in Central Asia.
 
• When Babur was 11 years old, his father died, and he became the ruler of Ferghana.
 
• However, he was soon driven out of his kingdom by his enemies, and he spent the next few years wandering in Central Asia and trying to regain his throne.
 
• Babur finally succeeded in regaining Ferghana in 1494 when he was 12 years old.
